input: Research and book a ski lesson for beginners

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing who the lesson is for (the user themselves, a child, a group) changes the type of lesson to search for — adult group, private, kids' programme, etc.
The ski resort or location determines which schools and instructors are available to research and book.
The target date or date range determines availability and urgency — booking weeks ahead vs. same-week changes the entire approach.
Whether the user wants a single taster lesson or a multi-day course significantly affects what to research and the total commitment.
Ski lessons range widely in price (group vs. private, school reputation); a budget ceiling narrows the options immediately.
Some learners prioritise private instruction, a specific language, instructor gender, or a highly-rated school — this shapes which options to shortlist.
Understanding what a successful lesson looks like (confidence on a green run, overcoming fear, a fun experience for a child) guides which school and format to recommend.

gold.taskTitle: Research and book a beginner ski lesson
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and book a ski lesson suitable for beginners at an unspecified location and time.

questions.title: Who is the ski lesson for exactly?
questions.description: Establish whether this is for yourself, a child, a group of friends, or a mix — this determines the lesson format (adult group, kids' programme, private, semi-private).

questions.title: Which ski resort or area are you heading to?
questions.description: Identify the specific resort or region so the research can be narrowed to ski schools and instructors actually available there.

questions.title: What dates do you need the lesson booked for?
questions.description: Pin down the target date or date range to check availability and set the right urgency for booking.

questions.title: Is this a one-off lesson or a multi-day course?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single introductory session or a structured beginner programme spanning several days.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget per person for the lesson?
questions.description: A budget ceiling immediately filters out private instruction or premium schools if cost is a concern, focusing research on realistic options.

questions.title: Do you have any strong preferences for the instructor or school?
questions.description: Check whether the user has preferences such as private vs. group tuition, instruction language, instructor gender, or a specific school they have heard of.

questions.title: What does a successful lesson look like to you?
questions.description: Understanding the desired outcome — e.g. skiing down a gentle slope independently, overcoming fear, or just having fun — helps select the right school and teaching style.
